nodes.description: Public token symbol string, set once in the constructor.
Public token name string, set once in the constructor.
Public token decimals (uint8), set once in the constructor.
Total token supply, assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of account balances, mutated by transfer() and transferFrom().
Nested mapping of allowances, written by approve()/approveAndCall() and transferFrom().
Constructor that initializes symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-mints the whole supply to the owner address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the balance of the given tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd, emits Transfer.
Overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] with tokens and emits Approval; classic approve race-condition surface.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements the caller's allowance using safeSub/safeAdd.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender] remaining allowance.
Sets allowance then performs an external call into spender's receiveApproval(); state is written before the untrusted external call.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
Overflow-checked addition used by transfer and transferFrom return paths.
Underflow-checked subtraction used to debit balances and allowances.
Overflow-checked multiplication helper, unused by the token logic.
Division helper with zero-divisor check, unused by the token logic.
Caller-controlled address used as the debit account and allowance owner in transfer/approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall.
Untrusted external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after the allowance state write; spender is fully attacker-controlled and can re-enter the token.
approve()/approveAndCall() unconditionally overwrite the existing allowance, enabling the well-known approval double-spend / race condition.
Destination address parameter of transfer().
Amount parameter of transfer().
Spender address parameter of approve().
Allowance amount parameter of approve().
Source address parameter of transferFrom().
Destination address parameter of transferFrom().
Amount parameter of transferFrom().
Spender address parameter of approveAndCall(), also the target of the external call.
Allowance amount parameter of approveAndCall().
Arbitrary calldata bytes forwarded to the spender's receiveApproval().
Account address parameter of balanceOf().
Owner address parameter of allowance().
Spender address parameter of allowance().

edges.reason: msg.sender is the untrusted caller whose balance is debited in transfer().
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve().
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom().
msg.sender is used both as the allowance owner and the forwarded 'from' argument in approveAndCall().
balances mapping is read and written by transfer().
balances mapping is read and written by transferFrom().
allowed mapping is written by approve().
allowed mapping is read and decremented by transferFrom().
allowed[msg.sender][spender] is written before the external call in approveAndCall(), so re-entering code observes inconsistent allowance state.
allowed mapping is read by allowance().
_totalSupply is initialized in the constructor.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply (minus balances[address(0)]).
symbol state variable is set in the constructor.
name state variable is set in the constructor.
decimals state variable is set in the constructor.
transfer() calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer() calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom() calls safeSub on balances[from] and on the allowance.
transferFrom() calls safeAdd to credit balances[to].
approve() performs the unconditional allowance overwrite flagged as the approval double-spend surface.
approveAndCall() writes allowed state before handing control to the untrusted spender contract.
approveAndCall() executes the untrusted external receiveApproval() call.
The untrusted spender contract invoked by receiveApproval() can call back into approveAndCall()/transferFrom() before the original call completes.
The attacker-supplied spender parameter is the target contract of the external call.
to parameter flows into the credited balances slot in transfer().
tokens parameter flows into safeSub/safeAdd inside transfer().
spender parameter keys the allowed mapping in approve().
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance value in approve().
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom().
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom().
tokens parameter is subtracted from balance and allowance in transferFrom().
spender parameter keys the allowed mapping in approveAndCall().
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance and forwarded in approveAndCall().
data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval() call.
tokenOwner parameter keys the balances lookup in balanceOf().
tokenOwner parameter keys the allowed lookup in allowance().
spender parameter keys the inner allowed lookup in allowance().

normalization_plan.reason: Address parameter used only as the credit target inside transfer(); it carries no independent security semantics.
Amount parameter consumed only by safeSub/safeAdd within transfer().
Spender parameter used only as the allowance key inside approve().
Amount parameter stored directly as the allowance value in approve().
Source address parameter consumed only by the balance/allowance updates in transferFrom().
Destination address parameter consumed only by the credit update in transferFrom().
Amount parameter consumed only by the safeSub/safeAdd updates in transferFrom().
Spender is both the allowance key and the untrusted target of the external call, so it merges into the unsafe operation node.
Amount parameter used only as the allowance value and forwarded calldata value.
Arbitrary bytes are passed straight to the untrusted external call, so the parameter belongs to that unsafe operation.
Lookup address consumed only by the read-only balanceOf() query.
Owner address consumed only by the read-only allowance() query.
Spender address consumed only by the read-only allowance() query.
